desc:
🎨 Welcome to Paint A Football Player!

⚽ Paint your favourite football players block by block
🖌️ Search thousands of players and recreate their portraits
👥 Paint with up to 4 friends in real-time

Your progress saves automatically, so you can continue anytime!

The game is new, so you may encounter a few bugs.
👍 Like the game and join the group for rewards!
